digest.component_or_area: history-strip operational script and dry-run harness
propositions: Build a committed one-time history-strip script using stock Git plumbing (fast-export/fast-import) to remove .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes from all historical commits while preserving DAG topology, merge commits, and empty commits.

Prove the script on a fresh unfiltered --no-tags scratch clone before any publication, verifying commit/merge counts match, tree byte-identity is preserved after dynamic re-add, and target prefixes are absent from history except HEAD.
Reject execution on partial (blob:none) clones and enforce remote ref immutability: source branch and protected tag must remain unchanged after the dry run, with no push operations performed.

Ensure the rewritten branch pack size does not exceed 150 MB ceiling and validate the re-add set is derived dynamically from git ls-tree rather than hardcoded, so future .bridge_state/ extensions remain safe.

Parse fast-export data blocks by byte length (not line-based grep) to correctly handle commit messages that begin with command-like bytes (M or D), and assert all graph/tree/history/tag checks complete before emitting final success.
